scope: Host file-notification/control tests, real bounded host Cargo build, and real VM apply/readiness/rollback. No combined source-save/build/reload watcher or physical-desktop/performance acceptance.

architecture.developer_tool: External Python standard-library inotify/build coordinator; desktop domain, ports, components and renderer have no dependency on it.
architecture.build: One coalesced build at a time; source freshness checked at publication and pre-apply; newest pending success waits while session guards are active.
architecture.deployment_adapter: Owned Lucent service, checked atomic exchanges, durable backups/journal, native readiness and startup survival, guarded restoration on failure.
architecture.scope: Three ordinary clients and seven generated theme support files; secure clients, authentication, supervisor, unit and compositor integration require their normal installation workflow.

local_checks.file_notifications: Real Linux inotify temporary-tree tests; build/watch coordination uses controlled fakes.
local_checks.rollback_cgroup: Real stop/drain implementation exercised with a populated root and drained captured Lucent cgroup.

native_trial.virtual_machine: QEMU/KVM, 4 vCPU, 3072 MiB; Hyprland; native RADV RENOIR/Mesa 26.2.2
native_trial.deliberate_failure: Valid ELF /usr/bin/false with matching manifest; all ten files published and candidate start attempted; journal ended rolled-back with rollback_complete true.

earlier_failed_trial.failure: Fast failed startup cleared the pending service ControlGroup. Recovery stopped the candidate, then incorrectly inspected the populated root cgroup before restoring files.
earlier_failed_trial.separate_guarded_recovery: Verified all ten original files restored, protected state preserved and desktop survival; original failed receipt unchanged.
earlier_failed_trial.fix: Rollback passes the original captured Lucent cgroup into stop/drain; empty/root cgroups are rejected before stop. Three regression tests added before the fresh passing trial.

not_claimed: Continuous source-save to Cargo to installed-session reload watcher acceptance
Physical installed desktop startup, suspend/resume and multi-monitor acceptance
Animation smoothness, 60 FPS, or RSS/performance target acceptance
Acceptance or merge of the VM bundle source separate rendering/performance work
In-process Rust hot module replacement or preservation of transient shell UI
